plugin.name: Usage Buddy
plugin.description: Your pet reflects live Claude and Codex usage read from a local usage monitor endpoint.
config.pollSeconds.label: Poll interval (seconds)
config.pollSeconds.description: How often to read the local usage endpoint, in seconds. Minimum 15.
config.port.label: Monitor port
config.port.description: Localhost port where the usage monitor serves /usage. Only takes effect for local/dev (Load Folder) installs: a catalog-installed package can reach only its declared host, so changing this also requires editing network.hosts in openpets.plugin.json to 127.0.0.1:<port>.
config.providerFilter.label: Providers to watch
config.providerFilter.description: Which providers the pet reacts to.
config.thresholds.label: Alert thresholds (%)
config.thresholds.description: Comma-separated utilization percentages that mark band boundaries, e.g. 50,75,90,100.
config.quietStatus.label: Quiet status
config.quietStatus.description: Only update the status bar when a warning or error tone applies.
config.hiddenWindows.label: Hidden windows
config.hiddenWindows.description: Comma-separated usage window names to ignore entirely (not shown, never drives mood). Defaults to nimbus_quill. Clear to show all.
commands.usageNow.title: Usage Now
commands.usageNow.description: Ask your pet for a full read-out of every usage window.
commands.usageMood.title: Usage Alert
commands.usageMood.description: Ask your pet how tight your quota is right now, in its own words.
line.steady: {name} is warming up, steady as she goes. ({pct}% {window})
line.toasty: {name} is getting toasty — ease off soon. ({pct}% {window})
line.low: {name}, ai ai ai — running low mate! ({pct}% {window})
